'''BeamStreaks''' were a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] known for its exceptional speed.<ref name="FATE" />

==Characteristics==
Manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]], BeamStreaks were very expensive, and were advertised as being "so fast that to crash in one was to [[Death/Legends|die]] in one."<ref name="FATE" /> This reputation for speed was well deserved, with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once remarking that a normal speeder would need to have its power train modified with numerous quad-feeds and thrust-boosters to even begin to give a BeamStreak a good race.<ref name="VORTEX">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> Described as ruggedly sleek, BeamStreaks were used by [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Enforcement Services]] as pursuit speeders, though were also used by various militaries, such as [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Supercommando|Supercommandos]].<ref name="FATE" />
